decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that strengthens the firm's core infrared heater range, costs little to carry and can be used across several heater lines.

The plaque heater has its own website page and fits the firm's established hall-heating business, so a 2022 shortfall from the gas price surge more likely triggers search for adjacent offers than dropping a core product.
The luminous radiant heater belongs to the firm's core gas infrared offer, and with no clear evidence of failure, its established customer base makes keeping it the satisficing choice.
This multi-model tube heater line is central to the narrow product range, and despite energy-crisis pressure the firm would protect it rather than weaken its core.
The standard plaque heater has its own website page and serves price-sensitive core customers, so it is likely kept even while the firm searches for lower-carbon alternatives.

This tube heater overlaps with the Product D line, so it is the most likely candidate for consolidation if rising gas prices and decarbonisation rules depress results, but it still belongs to the core offer.
